items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So when Bell said, 'Why don't you come down Monday, I have a friend and I think you two would get along very well,' so I said all right. So I went down to his place

ctx.x: Found out what I wanted to know there. Now the other part, I'd have to go around. So we came back to New York and Mandell couldn't go to the coast. So I went over to Billy Reeves' Little Club and I'd heard a trio over there and a guitar player who I liked very much. So when Bell said, 'Why don't you come down Monday, I have a friend and I think you two would get along very well,' so I said all right. So I went down to his place and he was going to cook chicken and I think we were back up --work opposite Duke,…
